services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: Jet Ski Rental Hop on a 2-seater Yamaha Ex Sport Waverunner for the ride of a lifetime! Trip Description: 1-Hour Ride Inside our Riding Zone Perfect for Both Beginners or Experts “Guides” on the Water with You at All Times 15- Minute Orientation Before Departing 1-Passenger Switch per Rental (No Driver Switches) Each rental is 1 hour. There will be a 15-minute safety briefing before departure. Requirements Operator MUST be 18 years or older with a Valid Driver's License Passengers MUST be 6 years or older Operator MUST have a basic understanding of the English Language All 1-Hour Rental • Must be 18+ to operate with a Valid License • Age 6+ to ride along

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Dewey Beach Sunset Cruise Set sail aboard a stunning sunset cruise located on the bay in Dewey Beach, Delaware. With the best view of the sunset over the Rehoboth Bay, our certified captain is here to escort your group during the most charming hour of the day. Our cruises allow for groups of 6 or less and run each night from 7:00 PM until 8:30 PM. Trip Description: 1.5 Hour Chartered Sunset Cruise USCG Licensed Captain Provided 6 Passengers or Less. (No Exceptions) Cruise Around the Rehoboth Bay and/or Lewes Canal BYOB is permitted. ##(NO HARD LIQUOR) What's Included? All Safety Equipment 1.5 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Pontoon Boat Charter
services.desc: Dewey Beach Pontoon Boat Charter Trip Description 2 Hour Chartered Cruise USCG Licensed Captain Provided 6 Passengers or Less. (No Exceptions) Cruise Around the Rehoboth Bay and/or Lewes Canal BYOB is permitted. ##(NO HARD LIQUOR) What's Included? All Safety Equipment (Life Vests, Anchor, First Aid Kit, Etc.) USCG Licensed Captain Bluetooth Radio Bimini Top Covering 40% of the Boat Fuel 2 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Banana Boat Rides - Rusty Rudder Location
services.desc: Get Wet & Have a Blast as You Tube Across the Waters of the Rehoboth Bay in Dewey Beach Ride Time 20 Minutes About Our Coast Guard licensed captain will take up to 6 riders at a time out for some family fun on the water. Everyone gets approximately 15-20 minutes of ride time on the banana. Safety is our priority and we do our best to accommodate everyone! All participants wear CG approved life jackets. Ages 5 and up are welcome to participate. Children under 18 will need a parent or guardian, to sign a participation waiver. Please note that the Banana Boat needs at least 2 Riders in order to 20 Minute Ride • Ages 6+
